title_en: Specific Measures of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force for Implementing the System of Police Ranks for Officers

articles.content_en: I. The police ranks of the officers of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force are the titles, insignia, and honors granted by the State to the officers, which distinguish their grades and indicate their status.

II. The establishment of the police rank grades for active-duty officers of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force shall be carried out by reference to the provisions of Article 7 of Chapter II of the Regulations on the Military Ranks of Officers of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.
The title "Armed Police" shall be prefixed to the police rank of an officer. The title "Armed Police Technical" shall be prefixed to the police rank of a technical officer.

V. The basic principles and standards for evaluating and conferring police ranks on active-duty officers shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Central Military Commission.

VIII. The demotion, cancellation, and deprivation of police ranks of active-duty officers shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of Chapter VI of the Regulations on the Military Ranks of Officers of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

IX. The ceremony for conferring police ranks on active-duty officers shall be held at the same time as the announcement of the order conferring the police ranks. The ceremony for conferring the ranks of general officers shall be organized and implemented by the Armed Police Headquarters, and leading comrades of the State Council and the Central Military Commission, or relevant comrades entrusted by the State Council and the Central Military Commission, shall attend to confer the ranks. The ceremony for conferring the ranks of field officers and company-grade officers shall be organized and implemented by the organs of the Armed Police Headquarters, general detachments, detachments, academies, and other units at the army or division level in light of specific circumstances.

X. The patterns of epaulettes and insignia for police ranks of officers of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force and the method of wearing them shall be promulgated by the State Council and the Central Military Commission.
For matters not specified in the preceding articles, the relevant provisions of the Regulations on the Military Ranks of Officers of the Chinese People's Liberation Army shall be followed.

While implementing the police officer rank system, the Chinese People's Armed Police Force shall also implement the civilian cadre system in accordance with the Interim Regulations on Civilian Cadres of the Chinese People's Liberation Army promulgated by the Central Military Commission. The conversion of some active-duty police officers to civilian cadres shall be organized and implemented by the General Headquarters of the Armed Police Force in light of actual circumstances.

Soldiers of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force shall implement the soldier police rank system in accordance with the Regulations on Active Service Soldiers of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. The titles shall be different from those of the People's Liberation Army. Those awarded soldier police ranks shall be renamed as "Police Sergeant Major", "Professional Police Sergeant", and "Police Sergeant", and soldiers shall be prefixed with "Armed Police" before their police ranks. The distinctions between grades of other soldiers' police ranks shall be the same as those of the soldiers' military ranks of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.
The soldier police rank system of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force shall be organized and implemented by the General Headquarters of the Armed Police Force.
